evidence_boundary.claim: P1 tests an exposed Source-episode probe-order Workflow only. A PASS permits a fresh plan; it is not Capability, Transfer, or deployment evidence, and Source scores never directly execute a Program.

protocol.A3: rank 24 donor+dose probes by Target Support first-order proxy gain
protocol.A5: rank probes by a Source-only dataset-LODO least-squares prior; Source never executes an action without exact Target Support confirmation
protocol.evaluation: complete dataset leave-one-out over four exposed datasets
protocol.harmful_direction_definition: a dataset-direction with fixed Query exact gain <0 at any B in {1,2}
protocol.oracle: exhaustive first-two probe order maximizing exposed B=0/1/2 AdaptAUC under the same Target confirmation rule

response_observation.centroid: mean over the six frozen ANCHORS
response_observation.mismatch: L2(donor centroid - Query cohort centroid) / sqrt(48)
response_observation.per_origin_response: (actual 48-step horizon - recursive seasonal-naive horizon) / robust context scale

protocol.source_model: dataset-equal weighted least squares with Source-fitted frozen standardization and intercept; no neural model
protocol.target_confirmation: open exact grouped Support gain for the first B probes; execute only the probed candidate with maximum exact Support gain when it is >0

scientific_question: Can Source PolicyEpisodes plus cross-series response alignment improve donor+dose probe ordering over Target-only first-order proxy ordering at the same exact Target Support feedback budget?
